scope.purpose: Show how far a task of known size has gone, or that a longer task is under way.
useCases: Upload or import with a known size.
A multi-step process (step 3 of 5 shown as a fraction).
exclusions: Meters (a static value in a range, like disk usage): a separate semantic, later.
alternatives: Spinner for a short wait in a small place.

contract.scope: Progress contract: value, max, indeterminate, required label (showLabel), showValue, intent accent/success/warning/danger, size; indicator color.status.{intent}.icon on a color.surface.muted track with explicit 3:1 contrast pairs; component tokens component.progress.thickness.{sm,md,lg}; motion.duration.loop sweep.
contract.provenance: User at the grouped wave 3 contract gate in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c543GZBnpgBmqmSNfDLB (2026-11-03), on the review page https://claude.ai/artifact/3WoVBXoZev2vBWUUJny9A8 (version 3): "Je valide les 10 contrats. Ensuite : 1. ok (meme si le wording scrim n'est pas très parlant...) 2. Ok 3. Ok 4. Oui 5. Ok, à juger dans l'implémentation".

checks.name: npm run validate (schema, consistency, token coverage in 18 contexts, dependencies)
npm run build:tokens (coverage and contrast evidence)

decisionsTaken: Linear bar only, with a required label shown above it by default (showLabel) and an optional percentage (showValue, tabular figures).

Indicator colors reuse color.status.{intent}.icon (accent, success, warning, danger): these roles already reach 3:1 on surfaces; the contract contrast block measures them against the track (color.surface.muted), surface.default and surface.overlay in 18 contexts: 0 failures.
Component tokens component.progress.thickness.{sm,md,lg} = 4, 6, 8 px (a value meaningful for Progress only).

Indeterminate: a one-third segment sweeping once per motion.duration.loop (new semantic role shared with Skeleton, 1500 ms), three times slower under reduced motion; value changes transition over motion.duration.base.
nextAction: Implementation phase (ggb-svelte): component folder, examples page, SSR and browser tests, self-contained preview; Firefox and WebKit smoke projects before the first overlay implementation gate; then the grouped wave 3 implementation review.
